notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has a real SoundEntries.dbc-driven audio path (weighted variant selection with no-immediate-repeat, per-entry volume/distance policy, loops and holds, off-thread MCI playback) covering spell kit sounds, missile audio, and a broad set of UI panel cues routed through PlayUiSound. Everything else in Benilla's sound surface - the ambient world soundscape and all server-driven sound opcodes - is absent.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The selection core (weighted variants, distance gating) is genuinely reference-shaped; the gap is breadth, not depth - roughly 8 of 18 sound-related opcodes are wired per the registry stats and the ambient half of the soundscape does not exist.
